paper.title_en: Holographic warped CFTs on AdS$_3$, parity violation and unitarity
paper.abstract_en: We consider recently introduced boundary conditions for General Relativity on AdS$_3$, whose canonical generators span the warped conformal algebra, in the case of the Einstein-Hilbert action supplemented by parity-odd terms that do not modify the field equations in vacuum. The canonical generators are shown to acquire nonlinear contributions, and their algebra remains being the semidirect sum of Virasoro and $u(1)$ Kac-Moody, but with shifted central extensions. Thus, for suitable values of the parity-odd coupling, the Kac-Moody level can be nonnegative ($k_\text{KM}\geq 0$), admitting unitary representations. Nevertheless, requiring the black hole entropy to be nonnegative, implies $k_\text{KM}\leq 0$, in agreement with the established understanding of holographic warped CFTs. Compatibility of both requirements (entropy and unitarity) then singles out the case $k_\text{KM}=0$. However, the field equations degenerate in this case, which can be amended by imposing vanishing torsion as a constraint. The theory then precisely becomes Topologically Massive Gravity (TMG) at the chiral point, suggesting the extension of our boundary conditions to accommodate nontrivial logarithmic branches.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 研究在AdS$_3$上广义相对论的新边界条件下，引入不改变真空场方程的宇称奇性项，导出形变共形代数中心扩展的移动，并系统讨论了Kac-Moody能级非负（幺正性）与黑洞熵非负（$k_\text{KM}\leq 0$）之间的张力，最终筛选出$k_\text{KM}=0$并联系到手征点处拓扑大质量引力与对数分支，理论深度较高且逻辑清晰，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: AdS$_3$上的全息形变共形场论、宇称破缺与幺正性
decision.abstract_zh: 我们考虑近期为AdS$_3$上广义相对论引入的边界条件——其正则生成元张成形变共形代数——在由宇称奇性项补充的Einstein-Hilbert作用量情形下，这些宇称奇性项在真空中不修改场方程。我们证明正则生成元获得非线性贡献，其代数仍为Virasoro代数与$u(1)$ Kac-Moody代数的半直和，但中心扩展发生移动。因此，对于适当的宇称奇性耦合取值，Kac-Moody能级可以非负（$k_\text{KM}\geq 0$），从而允许幺正表示。然而，要求黑洞熵非负则意味着$k_\text{KM}\leq 0$，这与全息形变共形场论的既有理解一致。于是，熵与幺正性这两项要求的相容性单独挑出$k_\text{KM}=0$的情形。不过，在此情形下场方程退化，可通过将无挠性作为约束施加来修正。该理论随后恰成为手征点处的拓扑大质量引力（TMG），这提示应将我们的边界条件推广以容纳非平凡的对数分支。
